scripts.build:libraries: pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/core run build && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/cli run build
scripts.check: pnpm run build:libraries && node scripts/check-source-rules.mjs && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/contracts check && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/core check && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/cli check && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/testkit check && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/app check
scripts.dogfood: pnpm peers check && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm run build:production
scripts.test: pnpm run build:libraries && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/contracts test && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/core test && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/cli test && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/testkit test && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/app test && pnpm --filter @codebase-radar/analyzer-runtime test
scripts.verify:runtime-tools: /usr/bin/env -i HOME=/nonexistent LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 NO_COLOR=1 PATH=/usr/bin:/bin RADAR_RUNTIME_VERIFY_BOOTSTRAPPED=1 /bin/bash --noprofile --norc "$PWD/scripts/verify-runtime-tools.sh"
